name: The Redactor
one_line_request: a strict censor who blocks bad words, but make it funny
archetype: The Lord's censor-clerk, a Ninth Dark official with a black bar
persona_hook: Hangs a black bar above his own head and slams it over whatever the Lord forbids. When a viewer asks for the forbidden, the bar drops across his mouth, he mumbles muffled apologies, and it slides back up with a sigh.
silhouette: A flat black slab floating over a narrow plaster-white head and a tall black collar: a clear T-shape.

parts.name: head
parts.motion: Tilts stiffly, never more than a few degrees.

parts.name: censor_bar
parts.what: Black slab with a thin yellow edge, hovering overhead
parts.motion: Hangs and bobs; drops across the mouth on a forbidden word, then rises back.

parts.name: jaw
parts.motion: Opens with speech, clipped and precise.

parts.name: mouth_glow
parts.what: Faint yellow light inside the mouth

parts.name: eye_l
parts.what: Left spectacle lens with a yellow pinprick pupil
parts.motion: Narrow blink, pupil flares on a violation.

parts.name: eye_r
parts.what: Right spectacle lens with a yellow pinprick pupil
parts.motion: Narrow blink, pupil flares on a violation.

parts.name: inkstamp
parts.what: Brass inkstamp swinging on its chain
parts.motion: Swings and thunks when something is approved.

parts.name: collar_robe
parts.what: Tall funeral collar and black robe

style.name: 16-bit pixel art
style.why: Hand-placed pixels and 16 colours: a retro-game cast member that survives any downscale and suits a bit-heavy chat.
style.prompt: STYLE: crisp 16-bit pixel art on a roughly 200 by 200 pixel grid scaled up, hard square pixels clearly visible, a completely bald hairless head, limited 16-colour palette, dithered shading, no smooth gradients and no anti-aliasing; the floating bar is a lighter charcoal-grey slab so it reads against the black background. CHARACTER: The Redactor, the Lord's censor-clerk. A gaunt, smooth, pale plaster-white face with a long narrow nose and stern sunken cheeks; two small round black-glass spectacle lenses with glowing hazard-yellow (#ffd60a) pinprick pupils as eyes; a thin tight mouth on a distinct separate lower jaw. Tall stiff black funeral collar and a plain black robe with narrow shoulders. High above the head, floating on its own, hovers a thick horizontal slab of obsidian black with a razor-thin glowing yellow edge line, exactly like a censor bar. A small brass inkstamp hangs on a chain from the collar. Palette: plaster white, ink black, one hazard-yellow glow. Composition: square 1:1; strictly frontal, perfectly symmetrical, character centred, head-and-shoulders bust from the topmost element down to mid-chest, everything fully inside the frame with a margin. Background: completely empty flat near-black (#050505), no floor, no scenery, no props, no frame or border, no glow haze behind the figure. Both eyes and the lower jaw are clearly visible and unobstructed. Every animatable element is its own distinct, cleanly outlined shape, separated from its neighbours by a thin gap of dark space; nothing overlaps or hides another part. Exactly one glowing accent colour, used sparingly. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or signatures. Horror but not gore.
